# LineChart

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Line chart that renders connected data points with straight lines. Now supports multiple series for comparing datasets. Uses the ICanvas interface for rendering, making it backend-agnostic.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `CartesianChartBase`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new LineChart()
new LineChart(ChartData data)
```

## Properties

- [`DefaultLineWidth`](#defaultlinewidth): Default line width for all series (can be overridden per series via Style).
- [`DefaultMarkerRadius`](#defaultmarkerradius): Default marker radius for all series (can be overridden per series via Style).
- [`DefaultShowMarkers`](#defaultshowmarkers): Whether to show data point markers by default (can be overridden per series via Style).
- [`LineColor`](#linecolor): Default color for single-series charts (backward compatibility).
- [`Sparkline`](#sparkline): Uses the chart box for a compact plot without axes, labels or legend.
